Class Vt100TokenWindow

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.Vt100TokenWindow
public final class Vt100TokenWindow extends Object
The Vt100TokenWindow type counts tokens for the VT100 console. The name VT100 means the console whose chat this window sums. The used side for a Roux user is that user's chat, and Roux is the chat these messages belong to. The stored count is the count Roux kept when the message was appended. The message with no stored count uses heuristic(String) on its text. The heuristic count is 1 when the text is empty. The heuristic count is (length + 3) / 4 for any other text. The Aetheris tab, the canvas tab, keeps the canvas estimate instead of the Roux sum. The private constructor refuses an instance. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#Vt100TokenWindow

  • Method Details

    • heuristic

      public static int heuristic(String text)
      The heuristic method delegates to HeuristicTokenCounter.count(String). The count is 1 when the text is null. The count is 1 when the text is empty. The count is (length + 3) / 4 for any other text.
      Parameters:
      text - The message text. The value may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the heuristic count.

    • messageCount

      public static int messageCount(Vt100TokenWindow.Line line)
      The messageCount method returns the token count for one message. The method returns 0 when the line is null. The method returns the stored count when the line is held and the stored count is 0 or higher. The method returns heuristic(String) when the line is held and the stored count is negative. The method returns heuristic(String) when the line is not held.
      Parameters:
      line - The message. The value may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the stored count, or the heuristic when the count was not stored.

    • sum

      public static int sum(Vt100TokenWindow.Line[] lines)
      The sum method adds messageCount(Vt100TokenWindow.Line) across the chat. The method returns 0 when the array is null. The null line adds 0. The running total is a long. The method returns Integer.MAX_VALUE when the total passes that limit.
      Parameters:
      lines - The Roux chat. The value may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the sum of the message counts.

    • characters

      public static int characters(Vt100TokenWindow.Line[] lines)
      The characters method adds the text length across the chat. The method returns 0 when the array is null. The method skips a null line. The method skips a line with null text. The running total is a long. The method returns Integer.MAX_VALUE when the total passes that limit.
      Parameters:
      lines - The Roux chat. The value may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the character count.

    • blocks

      public static int blocks(Vt100TokenWindow.Line[] lines)
      The blocks method counts the messages in the chat. The method returns 0 when the array is null. The method does not count a null slot. The method still counts a line with null text.
      Parameters:
      lines - The Roux chat. The value may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the number of messages.

    • tally

      public static Vt100TokenWindow.Tally tally(Vt100TokenWindow.Line[] lines)
      The tally method builds one Vt100TokenWindow.Tally for the chat. The used count is sum(Vt100TokenWindow.Line[]). The character count is characters(Vt100TokenWindow.Line[]). The message count is blocks(Vt100TokenWindow.Line[]). The null array produces zero for the used count. The null array produces zero for the character count. The null array produces zero for the message count.
      Parameters:
      lines - The Roux chat. The value may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the used count, the character count, and the message count.

    • available

      public static int available(int used, int budget)
      The available method subtracts the used count from the budget. The budget under 1 is unknown. The method returns -1 for an unknown budget. The method treats a negative used count as 0. The method returns 0 when the used count is past the budget. The method returns Integer.MAX_VALUE when the difference is past that limit.
      Parameters:
      used - The Roux sum.
      budget - The context window the token window already shows.
      Returns:
      The return value is the available approximation, or -1 when the budget is unknown.

    • estimateWord

      public static String estimateWord(int used)
      The estimateWord method builds the estimate label for a used count. The method paints a negative count as 0. The text is ESTIMATE followed by that count.
      Parameters:
      used - The Roux sum. The negative value paints as 0.
      Returns:
      The return value is est. tokens: and the count.

    • withEstimate

      public static String withEstimate(String strip, int used)
      The withEstimate method appends the estimate to a status strip. The method returns the estimate alone when the strip is null. The method returns the estimate alone when the strip is empty. The method returns the strip, two spaces, and the estimate for every other strip.
      Parameters:
      strip - The link, the facts, and the words already on the line. The value may be null.
      used - The Roux sum.
      Returns:
      The return value is the strip with the estimate.

    • usedFor

      public static int usedFor(boolean aetheris, int roux, int canvas)
      The usedFor method chooses the used count for the plate in front. The Aetheris plate keeps the canvas estimate. The SSH plate uses the Roux sum. The negative canvas estimate becomes 0 on the Aetheris branch. The negative Roux sum becomes 0 on the SSH branch.
      Parameters:
      aetheris - The flag is true when the Aetheris tab is in front.
      roux - The Roux sum.
      canvas - The inspector estimate for the canvas.
      Returns:
      The return value is the used side for the plate in front.

    • seat

      public static String[] seat(String[] bar)
      The seat method places ITEM on the menu bar. The item text is Token Calc. The null bar returns a one-element array that holds only that item. The method returns a copy of the bar when Token Calc is already present. The copy keeps the existing order. The method appends the item when ToolsThinking.HELP is absent. The method inserts the item immediately before the last Help name when Help is present.
      Parameters:
      bar - The names already on the bar. The value may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the bar with Token Calc included once.
